rooms.name: Spectral Bomb
rooms.description: You may destroy this Room to force an opponent to discard a random Spell card.

rooms.name: Monster Academy
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, gain (c) (c) for every miniboss you reveal from your hand.

rooms.name: Ancient Guardtower
rooms.description: When you build this Room, choose one opponent. Once this turn you may give them (c) to take one random Spell card from them.

rooms.name: Tomb of Terrors
rooms.description: You may discard this from your hand to draw a room or spell card from the Discard pile.

rooms.name: Imp Hoard
rooms.description: Once per turn when an opponent discards a card, you may put it in your hand.

rooms.name: Vampire Lab
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, you may discard a Miniboss to heal a Wound.

rooms.name: Haunted Cavern
rooms.description: Once per turn, You may pay (c) and choose a hero at the entrance to your dungeon. It cannot enter your dungeon until next turn.

rooms.name: Minion Clinic
rooms.description: When you build this Room, place up to three (c) on it. For each (c) you place, choose one card from the discard pile and put it in your hand. This Room has -1 for every (c) on it.

rooms.name: Robber's Vault
rooms.description: When you build this room, exchange your Hoard with another player's, even if you have no coins.

rooms.name: Minotaur Catacombs
rooms.description: Destroy this Room to return a Hero in it to the beginning of your Dungeon.

rooms.name: Goblin Market
rooms.description: Whenever you build a Room next to this Room, gain (c)(c).

rooms.name: Power Leech

rooms.name: Fetid Beast
rooms.description: Monster Rooms may not be built adjacent to this room. (But this Room may be built adjacent to other Monster Rooms.)

rooms.name: Training Camp
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Miniboss to double the damage of one of your Monster Rooms until end of turn.

rooms.name: Shrooman Aviary
rooms.description: You may discard this from your hand to give one hero +3 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Dragon's Nest
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, until end of turn, give every other Monster Room in your dungeon +1 for every treasure icon that room has.

rooms.name: Doppelganger Hive
rooms.description: This room has +1 for every Hero that was lured to your dungeon this turn.

rooms.name: Foyer Elemental
rooms.description: Once per turn when a Hero survives this Room, gain (c) (c).

rooms.name: Mysterious Portal
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, you may discard a Miniboss to draw a Spell card.

rooms.name: Alchemist's Lab
rooms.description: Once per turn, when you cast a Spell, gain (c) (c). (Cancelled spells are not cast.)

rooms.name: Black Market
rooms.description: Once per turn, when a Room in any dungeon is destroyed, pay (c) to draw a spell card.

rooms.name: Mind Thresher
rooms.description: Once per turn if a Hero dies in this Room, you may remove that Hero from the game to draw two Spell cards.

rooms.name: Cursed Well
rooms.description: You may discard this from your hand to draw a Spell card or gain (c) (c).

rooms.name: Loot Box
rooms.description: When you build this Room, pay (c)(c) and draw two Spell cards.

rooms.name: Crystal Ballroom
rooms.description: When you build this Room, place up to three (c) on it. For each (c) you place, draw one Spell card. This Room has -1 for every (c) on it.

rooms.name: Efreet's Chamber
rooms.description: Once per turn when a Hero is at the entrance to your dungeon, you may draw a Spell card to give this room -2 OR discard a Spell to give this room +2.

rooms.name: Magipede
rooms.description: This room has +1 for every Spell card in your hand.

rooms.name: Delver's Quarry
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, draw a Room card.

rooms.name: Garbage Chute
rooms.description: Once per turn when a Room is destroyed, gain (c) (c).

rooms.name: Unstable Mine
rooms.description: You may destroy this Room to gain (c) (c) (c).

rooms.name: Sawtooth Pendulum
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may pay (c) to kill a Hero in this Room with 3 or less Health.

rooms.name: The Catapult
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Miniboss to deactivate a Room in an opponent's dungeon.

rooms.name: Endless Gallery
rooms.description: You can destroy this room to add one treasure of any type to any player's dungeon until end of turn.

rooms.name: Paywall
rooms.description: Each turn, any player may give you any number of (c). For every (c) they give you, give this Room -1 until end of turn.

rooms.name: Living Trap
rooms.description: You may destroy a Monster room in your dungeon to kill a hero in this Room.

rooms.name: The Dreadmill
rooms.description: Once per Build phase, place a (c) on this Room. This Room has +1 for every (c) on it. If you cannot place a coin on this Room, destroy it.

rooms.name: Personnel Office
rooms.description: Once per turn gain (c) when an opponent plays or promotes a Miniboss.

rooms.name: Trophy Room
rooms.description: When you build or uncover this Room, Gain (c) for every multi-treasure Room in your dungeon, including this one.

rooms.name: Lightning Rod
rooms.description: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, gain (c)(c)(c).

rooms.name: Pixie Fountain
rooms.description: You may destroy this Room to gain (c) for every Wound you have.

rooms.name: The Keystone
rooms.description: You may destroy this Room to gain (c) for every Room remaining in your dungeon.

rooms.name: Pool of Shadows
rooms.description: Once per turn, you may discard a Spell to gain (c) (c).

spells.name: Windfall
spells.description: If you have no coins in your Hoard, gain (c)(c)(c).

spells.name: Internship
spells.description: Place the top three cards of the Room deck in the discard pile. If one of these cards is a Miniboss, you may immediately build it. (In addition to your normal build turn.)

spells.name: Spirit Dragon
spells.description: Choose a Room in any dungeon. Until end of turn, it has one of each treasure type instead of its normal treasure.

spells.name: Sabotage!
spells.description:
Choose a Room. Until end of turn it has no ability text.
OR, if if you have more Minibosses than your opponent, deactivate that Room until end of turn.|

spells.name: Rage!
spells.description: Choose a Miniboss. For every level that Miniboss has, give its Room +1 until end of turn. AND, if you have only one Miniboss, you may then double the damage of that Room.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description: Yo may discard two Monster Room cards or one Miniboss card to kill one Hero in your dungeon.

spells.name: Rebirth
spells.description: Chose a player (including yourself). That playwe discards their hand and draws Rooms and Spells equal to the number of each they discarded.

spells.name: Smash!
spells.description:
Deal 2 damage to a Hero in your dungeon.
OR deal 4 damage to a Hero in a Room that contains a Miniboss.

spells.name: Pay to Win
spells.description: Choose a Room to gain +1 until end of turn, plus an additional +1 for each (c) you pay when you cast this spell.

spells.name: Zoning Board
spells.description: For your build turn, you may build an Advanced Room on top of any other Room, ignoring matching treasure icon requirements.

spells.name: Respawn
spells.description: Treat all of your Rooms as if they were just built.

spells.name: Heist
spells.description: Choose a Room in any dungeon. Until end of turn end that Room's treasure icons.

spells.name: Short Circuit
spells.description: Choose an opponent casting a spell. Until end of turn, that opponent must pay (c) for each spell they wish to cast. If they don't, that spell is cancelled.

spells.name: Traitor
spells.description: Choose an opponent's Miniboss. You may pay that opponent one (c) per that Miniboss's Level to take it and immediatly build it at that same level. You may not build a room this turn.

spells.name: Armor Up!
spells.description: Give a Hero +1 until end of turn AND give this Hero an additional +2 until end of turn for every (c) you spend when casting this spell.

heroes.name: Felicity, Joyful Nurse Felicity is an accomplished hero and sworn pacifist
Wolfhard, Teen Hero This young paladin fights all evil things, both ordinary and strange
Holkin, Propheteer Holkin plays many roles
Luz, Merciful Healer Luz is a fast-paced heroine who brings good vibrations an pwerful healing to any battle
Josie, Vampire Slayer Josie claims to have vanquished hundreds of vampires
Tess, Dwarven Shieldmaiden Tess risked banishment to become an adventurer
Steven the Human For Steve, anytime is the right time to go on an adventure! He may seem like a normal kid, but Steve and his friends will always find a way to save the day
Rotgut, Half-Giant Berserker Rotgut has the strength of his giantess mother, the courage of his human father, and the drinking skills that brought the unlikely pair together
Maxine, Sister of Steel  When her homeland was destroyed by apocalyptic magic, Maxine donned the sealed armor of her ancestors and set out to return order to the land
Joe the Smith From training dragons to building golems, this blacksmith is up for any adventure
